WITH raw AS (
 SELECT symbol,date,close FROM public.daily_bars WHERE symbol IN ('513500','511220') AND date BETWEEN DATE '2018-01-01' AND DATE '2026-11-12' AND close>0
), periods AS (
 SELECT symbol,date,close,
 LN(close/LAG(close,1) OVER w) AS ret1,
 LN(close/LAG(close,5) OVER w) AS ret5,
 LN(close/LAG(close,20) OVER w) AS ret20
 FROM raw WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY date)
), vol AS (
 SELECT symbol,date,ret5,ret20,
 STDDEV_SAMP(ret1) OVER(PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS vol20,
 COUNT(ret1) OVER(PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS n20
 FROM periods
)
SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
 'd',TO_CHAR(e.date,'YYYYMMDD'),
 'spyRet20',e.ret20,
 'spyVol20',e.vol20,
 'bondRet20',b.ret20,
 'bondMinusSpyRet5',b.ret5-e.ret5,
 'valid',e.n20=20 AND b.n20=20 AND e.ret20 IS NOT NULL AND b.ret20 IS NOT NULL AND e.ret5 IS NOT NULL AND b.ret5 IS NOT NULL
 ) ORDER BY e.date) AS state
FROM vol e JOIN vol b ON e.date=b.date AND b.symbol='511220'
WHERE e.symbol='513500' AND e.date>='2021-01-01';
